text: Delivered in e748dde. Op[From,To,Role,Evidence] is the typed semantic refinement over SemanticKernel; self-dual evidence is compiler-constrained and value-bound, unsafe assumptions are explicit, algebraic dual and metric adjoint are distinct, and secondOrder/compress/FunctionalFrame are implemented. Dense, sparse, diagonal, block, low-rank, Kronecker, lazy-affine, and matrix-free representations plus identity/associativity/block/hub laws and negative type cases pass on JVM and JS. Gale upstream 82d0e98/b065c4e added and preserved the matrix-free Kronecker primitive; ScalaFIM pins published Gale 441caa1. Full multivar suites pass: 284 JVM and 284 JS.
